purpose: Determine whether the publisher states a CC BY *version* for the Ensembl Variation paper.
sanitization: Only the two licence-bearing statements are retained, verbatim and in full, because the finding this lookup supports is a NEGATIVE - that no version is stated - and an auditor cannot check a negative against prose alone. Nothing else from the page is kept: no abstract, no body text, no navigation, no scripts. The page is mutable, so this is a point-in-time extract bounded by the access date.

records.note: Stated without a version number in the rendered licence statement. This extract covers the rendered licence statement and the copyright line only; it does not cover hyperlink targets or any other licence text elsewhere on the page.

records.verbatim: © The Author(s) 2018. Published by Oxford University Press

conclusion: The rendered licence statement says CC BY and carries no version number. This supports recording the version as NOT ESTABLISHED - it is deliberately not stated as 'no version appears anywhere on the page', which this extract cannot evidence. A version could exist in a hyperlink target or adjacent text outside what is retained here; the packet therefore asserts no version at all rather than asserting its absence.
